title: Self-Adhesive Tree Band – Insect Trap for Fruit Trees
descriptionHtml:
Protect your fruit trees – without poison

You've waited the whole season for nice fruit – and then larvae, ants and crawling insects come and ruin the harvest. You'd rather not spray poison, especially near what you're going to eat.

A simple barrier that just works

The self-adhesive tree band is wrapped around the trunk and forms a sticky ring that stops crawling insects before they reach branches and fruit. Non-toxic, odorless and completely free of chemicals – kind to both the tree and the environment.

Features

  • Non-toxic insect barrier – safe near edible fruit
  • Self-adhesive – easy to wrap around the trunk
  • 10 cm wide band that covers properly
  • Stops larvae, ants and crawling pests
  • Perfect for apple, pear and cherry trees

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
